novel_features.name: Local expression screener
novel_features.description: Run the site's screener expression language (close > sma50 and rs >= 70) from the terminal over the Nifty 200 metrics (live, falling back to your last stored snapshot).
novel_features.rationale: The expression language only runs in the browser; we evaluate it locally over 48 synced metrics so screens are scriptable.
novel_features.example: investorpaisa-pp-cli screen "close > sma50 and sma50 > sma200 and rs >= 70" --sector IT --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when an agent needs a custom multi-metric filter of the Nifty 200 instead of paging raw rows.

novel_features.name: One-stock deep dive
novel_features.description: Price, range, RSI/SMA/EMA, returns, sector percentile, signals, headlines and watchlist membership for one or more stocks in a single call.
novel_features.rationale: Joins universe, live, screener, news and watchlists that otherwise need five calls.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this first when asked about a specific stock.

novel_features.name: Movers with confluence
novel_features.description: Ranked gainers, losers, unusual volume, gappers and 52-week highs/lows, filtered by RS and sector.
novel_features.rationale: Joins live relVol/gap/signals to screener RS and trend.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Answers what is moving today and is also strong, in one call.

novel_features.name: Sector rotation heat
novel_features.description: Equal-weight sector returns over 1d-1y, average RS and % above 50/200 DMA, with rank change versus an earlier stored snapshot (--trend needs two stored days).
novel_features.rationale: The site shows only the day change; multi-window sector strength is derived locally.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for sector rotation questions across the sectors.

novel_features.name: Snapshot diff
novel_features.description: Which stocks entered or left conditions (new 52-week high, RS crossing 70, 50/200 DMA crossings, 2x volume) since an earlier stored snapshot; needs two stored trading days.
novel_features.rationale: No endpoint returns prior state; only local snapshots can be diffed.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Gives a morning agent the what-changed primitive without a scrape-and-diff script.

novel_features.name: Morning brief
novel_features.description: Index levels, breadth, your watchlist rows with change, RS and signals, and fresh headlines in one JSON document.
novel_features.rationale: Joins watchlists, live rows, screener rows, signals, news and breadth.
novel_features.why_it_matters: One call gives a scheduled agent the whole market-morning note.

novel_features.name: Breadth history
novel_features.description: Trend of advance/decline, % above 50/200 DMA, new 52-week highs and stocks at 52-week lows across your stored daily snapshots.
novel_features.rationale: The site shows only today's breadth; history exists only in the snapshots this CLI stores each time you sync.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Answers whether participation is widening or narrowing.

novel_features.name: Adjusted 5y history
novel_features.description: Five years of daily OHLCV, split/bonus adjustment factors and corporate events for a stock, read from its chart page and cached locally (--raw, --years, --tail).
novel_features.rationale: No JSON endpoint exists; the data is parsed from the chart page payload.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for long-horizon price context and backtests on adjusted prices.

narrative.headline: The Nifty 200 momentum screener, movers and market breadth in your terminal, with a local history that builds from your first sync.
narrative.value_prop: InvestorPaisa shows a clean Nifty 200 dashboard in the browser only, behind a Google sign-in. This CLI reuses your browser session, runs the site's screener expression language from scripts, and stores daily snapshots in SQLite so you can diff what changed since the last sync, track breadth over time, and hand an agent a one-call morning brief. Every live data command needs a signed-in session; --data-source local replays stored snapshots offline.
narrative.auth_narrative: InvestorPaisa is sign-in only (Google). Sign in to investorpaisa.com in Chrome, then run auth login --chrome (needs the pycookiecheat, cookies or cookie-scoop-cli helper; pip install pycookiecheat). Alternatives: auth login --cookies-file, piping the __Secure-authjs.session-token cookie value into auth set-token, or exporting INVESTORPAISA_SESSION_TOKEN as a cookie string (the cookie name, an equals sign, then its value). No password is ever handled.

troubleshoots.fix: Sign in to investorpaisa.com in Chrome, then run investorpaisa-pp-cli auth login --chrome (or refresh INVESTORPAISA_SESSION_TOKEN).

troubleshoots.symptom: auth login --chrome says no cookie tool found
troubleshoots.fix: Run pip install pycookiecheat, or use investorpaisa-pp-cli auth login --cookies-file <file> / pipe the cookie into auth set-token.

troubleshoots.symptom: changes, breadth or sectors --trend return an empty result with a note
troubleshoots.fix: They need at least two stored trading days; run investorpaisa-pp-cli sync on separate days.

troubleshoots.symptom: history says no chart data for a symbol
troubleshoots.fix: Check the symbol is in the Nifty 200 (investorpaisa-pp-cli universe list) and that your session is still signed in.

troubleshoots.symptom: Prices look stale after market hours
troubleshoots.fix: Live prices are last-traded values; the official close replaces them after the market shuts. Re-run sync after 16:00 IST.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for Indian large/mid-cap momentum questions on the Nifty 200: what is moving, which stocks pass a trend/RS filter, how breadth and sectors are shifting, and what changed since the last sync. Best for scheduled agent briefs and ad-hoc screens that need stable JSON.
anti_triggers: Fundamental data such as P/E history, balance sheets or earnings (the site does not provide them)
Placing orders or portfolio P&L (the site stores symbols only, no positions)
Renaming watchlists or adding/removing bookmarks (not implemented; watchlists support list, create, delete and set-items)
